Task: Put the red cube into the red tray and the blue cube into the blue tray.

Skill code (numbered):
  1| # skill module
  2| import math
  3| 
  4| def run(robot):
  5|     """
  6|     Place the red cube into the red tray and the blue cube into the blue tray.
  7|     Returns True if both placements succeed.
  8|     """
  9|     # ----- safety limits -------------------------------------------------
 10|     SAFE_X_MIN, SAFE_X_MAX = 0.04, 0.32
 11|     SAFE_Y_MIN, SAFE_Y_MAX = -0.26, 0.26
 12|     SAFE_Z_MIN, SAFE_Z_MAX = 0.014, 0.26
 13| 
 14|     # ----- parameters ----------------------------------------------------
 15|     FORWARD_OFFSET = 0.01          # m, small forward shift
 16|     LIFT_OFFSET = 0.02             # m, extra lift to clear the cube
 17|     CONTACT_OFFSET = 0.015         # m, distance from approach point to contact
 18|     RELEASE_HEIGHT = 0.015         # m, nominal height of the tray floor
 19|     LATERAL_FALLBACK = 0.02        # m, small shift if tray approach fails
 20|     MAX_GRASP_RETRIES = 2
 21|     MAX_ATTEMPTS = 30
 22|     LOW_SPEED = 0.05
 23|     APPROACH_SPEED = 0.07
 24| 
 25|     # ----- state ---------------------------------------------------------
 26|     placed = {"red": False, "blue": False}
 27|     attempts = 0
 28|     prev_center = {}               # remember previous centre for stability
 29|     grasp_retries = {"red": 0, "blue": 0}
 30| 
 31|     while not all(placed.values()) and attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS:
 32|         attempts += 1
 33|         robot.log(f"Attempt {attempts}")
 34|         obs = robot.observe()
 35|         objs = obs.get("objects", {})
 36|         fixtures = obs.get("fixtures", {})
 37| 
 38|         # ----- extract cube and tray poses ---------------------------------
 39|         cube_info = {}
 40|         for name, data in objs.items():
 41|             if data["shape"] == "cube":
 42|                 cube_info[data["color"]] = {
 43|                     "pose": data["pos"],
 44|                     "yaw": data["yaw"],
 45|                     "name": name,
 46|                 }
 47| 
 48|         # store only x,y for trays (fixture pos is [x, y, 0])
 49|         tray_info = {}
 50|         for name, data in fixtures.items():
 51|             if data["kind"] == "tray":
 52|                 tray_info[data["color"]] = data["pos"][:2]   # (x, y)
 53| 
 54|         # ----- process each colour -----------------------------------------
 55|         for colour in ("red", "blue"):
 56|             if placed[colour]:
 57|                 continue
 58|             cube = cube_info.get(colour)
 59|             tray = tray_info.get(colour)
 60|             if not cube or not tray:
 61|                 continue
 62| 
 63|             # ----- stability check (same centre for two frames) -------------
 64|             cur_center = tuple(cube["pose"])
 65|             if prev_center.get(colour) is not None:
 66|                 if math.dist(prev_center[colour], cur_center) > 0.002:  # >2 mm
 67|                     robot.log(f"Cube {colour} moved, resetting stability")
 68|                     prev_center[colour] = cur_center
 69|                     grasp_retries[colour] = 0
 70|                     continue
 71|             else:
 72|                 prev_center[colour] = cur_center
 73| 
 74|             # ----- pick‑up ---------------------------------------------------
 75|             g_yaw = cube["yaw"]
 76|             dx = math.cos(g_yaw) * FORWARD_OFFSET
 77|             dy = math.sin(g_yaw) * FORWARD_OFFSET
 78|             app_x = cube["pose"][0] + dx
 79|             app_y = cube["pose"][1] + dy
 80|             # clip to safe workspace
 81|             app_x = max(SAFE_X_MIN, min(SAFE_X_MAX, app_x))
 82|             app_y = max(SAFE_Y_MIN, min(SAFE_Y_MAX, app_y))
 83|             # lift a bit higher to avoid collision
 84|             app_z = cube["pose"][2] + LIFT_OFFSET
 85|             contact_z = app_z - CONTACT_OFFSET
 86| 
 87|             # ---- move to approach point (with fallback) --------------------
 88|             def try_approach(x, y, height, description):
 89|                 try:
 90|                     robot.log(f"Moving to approach {colour} cube at "
 91|                               f"({x:.3f},{y:.3f},{height:.3f})")
 92|                     resp = robot.move_to(x, y, height,
 93|                                          yaw=g_yaw, speed=APPROACH_SPEED)
 94|                     if not resp["ok"]:
 95|                         raise Exception("blocked on approach")
 96|                     return True
 97|                 except Exception as e:
 98|                     robot.log(f"{description} failed: {e}")
 99|                     return False
100| 
101|             # try nominal position first
102|             if not try_approach(app_x, app_y, app_z, "Approach"):
103|                 # try small lateral fallbacks
104|                 fallback_offsets = [(LATERAL_FALLBACK, 0), (-LATERAL_FALLBACK, 0),
105|                                     (0, LATERAL_FALLBACK), (0, -LATERAL_FALLBACK)]
106|                 for off_x, off_y in fallback_offsets:
107|                     nx, ny = max(SAFE_X_MIN, min(SAFE_X_MAX, app_x + off_x)), \
108|                              max(SAFE_Y_MIN, min(SAFE_Y_MAX, app_y + off_y))
109|                     if try_approach(nx, ny, app_z,
110|                                     f"Approach fallback {off_x:+.2f}/{off_y:+.2f}"):
111|                         break
112|                 else:
113|                     # all fallbacks failed – skip this colour
114|                     robot.log(f"All approach attempts failed for {colour}; skipping")
115|                     continue
116| 
117|             # ---- descend to contact ----------------------------------------
118|             if not try_approach(app_x, app_y, contact_z, "Contact"):
119|                 # fallback lateral shift for contact as well
120|                 for off_x, off_y in fallback_offsets:
121|                     nx, ny = max(SAFE_X_MIN, min(SAFE_X_MAX, app_x + off_x)), \
122|                              max(SAFE_Y_MIN, min(SAFE_Y_MAX, app_y + off_y))
123|                     if try_approach(nx, ny, contact_z,
124|                                     f"Contact fallback {off_x:+.2f}/{off_y:+.2f}"):
125|                         break
126|                 else:
127|                     robot.log(f"Contact move failed for {colour}; skipping")
128|                     continue
129| 
130|             # ---- close grasp -----------------------------------------------
131|             robot.log("Closing grasp")
132|             if not robot.grasp():
133|                 robot.log("Grasp failed")
134|                 robot.release()
135|                 grasp_retries[colour] += 1
136|                 if grasp_retries[colour] >= MAX_GRASP_RETRIES:
137|                     robot.log(f"Too many grasp failures for {colour}, skipping")
138|                     robot.release()
139|                     prev_center[colour] = None
140|                     continue
141|                 else:
142|                     # retry the whole attempt on next loop iteration
143|                     continue
144| 
145|             # verify that we really hold the intended cube
146|             held = robot.holding()
147|             if held != cube["name"]:
148|                 robot.log(f"Holding check failed: expected {cube['name']}, got {held}")
149|                 robot.release()
150|                 continue
151| 
152|             # ----- move to release zone ------------------------------------
153|             # use only the (x, y) part of the tray; clip to safe workspace
154|             tray_x = max(SAFE_X_MIN, min(SAFE_X_MAX, tray[0]))
155|             tray_y = max(SAFE_Y_MIN, min(SAFE_Y_MAX, tray[1]))
156| 
157|             release_z_above = RELEASE_HEIGHT + 0.02   # a little above the tray floor
158|             release_z_target = RELEASE_HEIGHT        # just above the floor
159| 
160|             def try_place(x, y, height, description):
161|                 try:
162|                     robot.log(f"Moving to release zone over {colour} tray at "
163|                               f"({x:.3f},{y:.3f},{height:.3f})")
164|                     resp = robot.move_to(x, y, height,
165|                                          yaw=None, speed=APPROACH_SPEED)
166|                     if not resp["ok"]:
167|                         raise Exception("blocked on tray approach")
168|                     return True
169|                 except Exception as e:
170|                     robot.log(f"{description} failed: {e}")
171|                     return False
172| 
173|             # 1) nominal position
174|             if not try_place(tray_x, tray_y, release_z_above,
175|                              "Tray approach"):
176|                 # 2) shift a little in x
177|                 if not try_place(max(SAFE_X_MIN, min(SAFE_X_MAX, tray_x + LATERAL_FALLBACK)),
178|                                  tray_y, release_z_above,
179|                                  "Shifted x+ fallback"):
180|                     # 3) shift a little in y
181|                     if not try_place(tray_x,
182|                                      max(SAFE_Y_MIN, min(SAFE_Y_MAX, tray_y + LATERAL_FALLBACK)),
183|                                      release_z_above,
184|                                      "Shifted y+ fallback"):
185|                         robot.log(f"All tray approaches failed for {colour}; skipping")
186|                         continue
187| 
188|             # lower to release height
189|             if not try_place(tray_x, tray_y, release_z_target,
190|                              "Release descent"):
191|                 robot.log(f"Release descent failed for {colour}; skipping")
192|                 continue
193| 
194|             # release the cube
195|             robot.log("Releasing cube")
196|             robot.release()
197| 
198|             # verify release; if still holding, try a small lift and release again
199|             if robot.holding() is not None:
200|                 robot.log("Release check failed, retrying lift")
201|                 try:
202|                     # lift a bit, release, then lower again
203|                     robot.move_to(tray_x, tray_y, release_z_above,
204|                                   yaw=None, speed=APPROACH_SPEED)
205|                     robot.release()
206|                 except Exception as e:
207|                     robot.log(f"Retry release move failed: {e}")
208|                     continue
209| 
210|             # success for this colour
211|             placed[colour] = True
212|             robot.log(f"Successfully placed {colour} cube")
213|             prev_center[colour] = None   # reset stability flag
214| 
215|         # small pause to let the simulation settle
216|         robot.wait(0.2)
217| 
218|     success = all(placed.values())
219|     robot.log(f"Skill finished, success={success}")
220|     return success
